items.briefing:
Australian organisations with home battery systems (such as solar storage) should be aware these devices are now considered a cybersecurity compliance concern, following new guidance highlighted this week. If your organisation or staff use internet-connected energy storage at home or on business premises, ensure firmware is kept up to date and default passwords are changed.

OpenAI has also introduced new user controls that better protect how its tools are used — a reminder that AI platforms staff use daily are still maturing in terms of safety features.

**Tip:** Check any smart energy devices on your network have strong, unique passwords set.
